summary: Confirmed the shape mismatch: planner-agent.md emits free-form prose checklist items with no **Task {P}.{N}**: prefix, while general/lean/nix implementation agents match on that literal prefix (12/3/5 occurrences respectively). Recommend a single canonical instruction that locates items by existing text and preserves the deviation-annotation suffix wording unchanged. planner-agent.md stays out of scope per the task's chosen resolution.
decisions_made: Loosen the instruction to match items by existing text rather than standardizing planner-agent.md onto the literal prefix; planner-agent.md is not edited by this task.

Preserve the deviation-annotation suffix wording (*(deviation: skipped — reason)*, *(deviation: altered — what changed)*, *(deviation: deferred to task N)*, *(completed)*, *(in progress)*) unchanged; only the assumed leading `**Task {P}.{N}**:` line shape is genericized.

general-implementation-agent.md needs two sites updated (Stage 4B-ii check-off instruction, Stage 4D-ii cross-referenced deviation examples); lean and nix agents need only their deviation-annotation example blocks updated (they have no separate check-off instruction).
